resources.string: Time-zone boundaries © OpenStreetMap contributors, distributed by timezone-boundary-builder and Timeshape under the Open Database License 1.0. Boundaries are bundled with the app; time-zone lookup sends no coordinates over the network.
Boundary source: Timeshape 2026b.29 · Copyright Roman Iakovlev 2018 · MIT tools and ODbL data. Geometry engine: Esri Geometry API 2.2.4 · Apache License 2.0.

Country, submitted place-search text and selected-pin address lookup use Android’s geocoding service when you enable network geocoding and request a lookup. Availability and accuracy depend on the device’s provider. Search does not read device location or journal history. Recorded coordinates and user corrections remain in your journal.
